title: The Runaways’ Ride
brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road and into the book. In Chapter 3, the prince wakes Jemmy in the night to run away. Build their ride in a forest, then take a photo for your teacher.
look: This stop is a forest at night, from Chapters 3 and 4. The prince and Jemmy ride a castle horse into the trees.

models.name: Basket
models.why: Jemmy carries it. Make it big!

steps.title: Know your models
steps.text: These are your four models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR: open your menu, click the **Canvas** tab, then pick our assignment.

steps.title: Go in
steps.text: Put on your headset and open the **On-Demand** app. Click the **Explore** tab. Type **Forest** in the **Filter environments** box and click **Medieval Forest**. Then click **Begin Solo**.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Press the **top button on your right controller** and click **Models**. Put the **horse** between the trees. Put the **basket** and the **cloak** next to it. Put the **moon** up high.

steps.title: Say it out loud
steps.frame: “The prince ran away because ___. He picked Jemmy because ___.”
steps.text: Point to the horse and say this out loud:
steps.spoken: Point to the horse and say this out loud. The prince ran away because… and finish the sentence. He picked Jemmy because… and finish that one too.

steps.title: Snap and submit
steps.fits: the horse, the basket, the cloak and the moon

extra.text: Add a **Frog** by the horse. Say why the prince once dumped bullfrogs in the moat.

points: Your photo shows the horse, the big basket, the cloak and the moon.

mapday.intro: No headset today? That’s okay. It’s Road Map Day. Read each clue from the book and tap the thing it names. Then finish two sentences about the runaways.

clues.q: “…carrying a wicker basket the size of a sea chest.”
“…the prince was wearing a black cloak…”
“The night moon had lit their way like a lantern.”
“…double-mounted on a horse from the castle stable…”

hints: Jemmy had to carry the basket
